commit.message:
Initial commit: FlareIntel — On-Chain Geopolitical & Financial Intelligence

Flare blockchain hackathon project bringing CII v8 risk scores on-chain
via FTSOv2 oracle feeds and FDC attestation.

Includes:
- 4 Solidity contracts (RiskDataToken, CIIOracleFeed, DataSubscription, CollateralManager)
- FTSOv2 CII submission pipeline with batch scoring
- FDC event attestation bridge for geopolitical events
- WorldMonitor Python adapter (CII v8 scoring methodology)
- Express REST API with on-chain data aggregation
- React dashboard with risk map and country rankings
- Hardhat deployment scripts for Coston2 testnet
- Full documentation and upstream attribution
